💡 cool-retro-term | QML
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a nostalgic and visually distinctive terminal emulator experience by replicating the appearance of old CRT monitors.
✨ Key Features: • Mimics old cathode tube screens • Eye-candy and customizable • Reasonably lightweight • Uses QML port of qtermwidget • Works on Linux and macOS
📖 Summary: Cool-retro-term is a terminal emulator that recreates the aesthetic of old cathode ray tube screens. It offers a visually appealing and customizable experience, mimicking the look and feel of vintage computer displays.
